bullets.title: Fresh low overnight
bullets.text: Gold slid further after the US close and sat at 3,621.40 bid at 01:34 SAST, just above a new day low of 3,620.40 (Kitco).

bullets.title: Big Thursday drop
bullets.text: Thursday ran from a 3,759.10 high to the low, about 140 dollars, as Kitco's PM report said gold fell below 3,650.

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed
bullets.text: Markets price a high chance of a quarter-point hike at the 8-9 December Fed meeting, which keeps pressure on gold (exact odds UNVERIFIED today).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index and US 10-year yield were near their highs on Thursday (about 103.9 and 5.05%); no fresh reading found for this morning (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Banks still positive
bullets.text: Morgan Stanley named gold its top commodity pick for 2027 and UBS called it resilient, but that is a long-term view, not a reason to buy today.

bullets.title: Oversold, thin hours
bullets.text: Price is stretched after a fast fall and Asian hours are quiet, so sudden bounces of 20-40 dollars are possible.

watch: Buying at 3,621 just because it looks cheap. Wait for the zone and a hold.

Fed speakers backing a December hike can push gold lower fast.
